compatibility.strategy: Historical artifact paths under artifacts/ are kept as Windows junctions where practical. Real files for testing evidence now live under project-testing/artifacts/.
compatibility.boundary: Do not write new testing, release, browser, smoke, live diagnostic, DB diagnostic, package, log, or legacy report artifacts directly into artifacts/.

entries.reason: Browser suite manifests, screenshots, and verification JSON are release-testing evidence.
Historical and current diagnostic run evidence belongs under the testing center; a junction preserves existing hardcoded evidence references.
Ad hoc smoke-test output is testing evidence.
Edge-case smoke-test output is testing evidence.
Historical phase 3 smoke-test output is testing evidence.
Historical phase 4 smoke-test output is testing evidence.
Live diagnostic captures are governed by the testing cockpit.
Live page probe artifacts are testing evidence.
Browser/runtime audit snapshots are verification evidence.
General debug screenshots are test/debug evidence unless already classified as UI-specific.
Legacy generated reports are preserved in the testing center as historical verification/governance artifacts; their business meaning remains governed by the original source code and docs.
Generated server/client process logs are testing/debug evidence.
Generated local dev-server logs are testing/debug evidence.
Generated temporary logs are testing/debug evidence.
Generated deployment/test packages are release artifacts.
